SQL pathway: 2026 foundation with 2027 revisions

Use the live pathway for sequenced explanations, textbook links and expected result tables: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/sql/

The student workbook and dictionaries work offline. Each exercise starts from a FRESH database: base for worked/guided, changed for independent. Open .sqlite directly OR run matching setup.sql once in an empty database. Enable foreign keys separately in every connection before a transaction. Scratch files are empty for CREATE practice. Model errors and constraint-failure tasks are deliberate; retain before/after evidence. The six-table seed.sql contains data only; author the schema from dictionary.md before loading it. Public SQL references/expected results are a separate download. SQLite is the chosen dialect; no code executes in this website. Teacher checkpoint: taught, changed independent attempt, feedback, fresh retry before assessment. Paper routes build reasoning but do not prove actual software enforcement.
